description:
Connect Claude to a Linux project workspace authorized by its owner. RemDesk can list and read text files, show permitted commands, and expose audit, task and usage records. When the account and host policy permit it, the connector can also write files, run named commands and submit bounded tasks. Command arguments are accepted only where the policy declares them. The current operator service is not read-only.

Access requires authorization to a configured workspace and OAuth consent; installing a plugin does not grant a host or an account. Tool availability and permissions depend on the account and server policy. Use a separate review workspace for testing write or execution operations.

This connector is distinct from RootRemDesk and the TvijoTerm owner terminal. It does not activate root access or a RootRemDesk subscription.
use_cases: Understand a permitted project using its actual files.
Inspect allowed commands before requesting an operation.
Review saved task results, audit metadata and account usage.
prerequisites: An authorized RemDesk identity, a configured project workspace and a supported Claude account. Customer self-service enrollment and every exposed tool must be verified before public launch.
